definition: [ צַפַף ] verb Pilpel chirp, peep (onomatopoetic; Late Hebrew Pilpal id. ; Jewish-Aramaic צַפְצֵף chirp ; Arabic sparrow , etc.); — Imperfect 3 feminine singular תְּצַפְצֵף Isa 29:4 , 1 singular אֲצַפְצֵף Isa 38:14 Participle מְצַפְצֵף Isa 10:14 , plural הַמְפְצְפִים Isa 8:19 — chirp, peep: 1. of birds Isa 10:14 (figurative of conquered peoples); of mourning, ׳ בְּסוּסאֲ֗֗֗צ Isa 38:14 (|| אֶהְנֶּה בַּיּוֺנָה ). 2. of spirits, ghosts Isa 8:19 (+ הַמַּהְגִּים ), ׳ מֵעָפָר אִמְרָתֵךְ תְּצ Isa 29:4 (like a spirit's).

BDB7206 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB7208

[צַפַף] verb Pilpel chirp, peep (onomatopoetic; Late Hebrew Pilpal id.; Jewish-Aramaic צַפְצֵף chirp; Arabic sparrow, etc.); — Imperfect 3 feminine singular תְּצַפְצֵף Isa 29:4, 1 singular אֲצַפְצֵף Isa 38:14 Participle מְצַפְצֵף Isa 10:14, plural הַמְפְצְפִים Isa 8:19 — chirp, peep:

1. of birds Isa 10:14 (figurative of conquered peoples); of mourning, ׳בְּסוּסאֲ֗֗֗צ Isa 38:14 (|| אֶהְנֶּה בַּיּוֺנָה).
2. of spirits, ghosts Isa 8:19 (+ הַמַּהְגִּים), ׳מֵעָפָר אִמְרָתֵךְ תְּצ Isa 29:4 (like a spirit's).
